claim.value: When the stated causal-support conditions do not hold, clarified histories should guide further testing.
claim.scope: Conditional use of histories after treating publication differences as associations.

provenance.rationale: P020 explicitly assigns clarified histories this role when the causal-support conditions are absent.

signal_basis.value: Histories are inspected and gaps clarified with participants while preserving original records. A within-window publication difference is observed, but the stated causal-support conditions do not hold, so it is treated as an association.
signal_basis.scope: Assumed occurrence of the proposed observations; failed checks or sparse evidence require retaining uncertainty and continuing targeted follow-up or observation.

provenance.rationale: These spans supply the clarification operation, proposed publication observation, association-only interpretation and limits on proceeding.
The claim is supported within its exploratory scope; no unresolved empirical relation is needed to license it.

rationale: Clarified histories can inform what to investigate next without establishing why publication changed. The claim licenses further testing, while explicitly retaining the association-only interpretation.
uncertainty: The histories do not establish a release effect or guarantee that subsequent testing will confirm an explanation.
